data.one_liner: Provides Dart Frog‑specific lint rules for static analysis.
data.what_it_does: The package supplies a set of analysis_options that enforce Dart Frog best practices. It integrates with the Dart analyzer to flag style and architectural issues specific to Dart Frog projects.
use_when: You want consistent code style across a Dart Frog backend
You need ready‑made lint rules tailored to Dart Frog
avoid_when: Your project does not use Dart Frog
You require a full lint suite covering all Dart/Flutter use cases
strengths: Zero runtime overhead, only static analysis
Simple to add as a dev dependency
weaknesses: Limited to Dart Frog, not useful for other frameworks
Provides fewer rules than general lint packages
data.setup_notes: Add as a dev dependency and include `package:dart_frog_lint/recommended.yaml` in analysis_options.yaml
